sub_answers.text: The agency's mandate is to stimulate and facilitate the business development and export activities of the Creative Industries in Trinidad and Tobago to generate national wealth. [d3565457s47p0] The company is responsible for the strategic and business development of the three niche areas and sub-sectors under its purview: Music, Film and Fashion. [d3565457s47p0]

sub_answers.sub_question: Which government ministry or department supervises the agency and what is its reported organizational structure?
sub_answers.text: The agency was established as a state agency under the Ministry of Trade and Industry. [d3565457s47p0] Its reported organizational structure includes the parent company (Trinidad and Tobago Creative Industries Company Limited, CreativeTT) with subsidiaries MusicTT, FilmTT and FashionTT established to fulfil its mandate. [d3565457s47p0]
